description: Source code for the AudioDeviceTypeAddr class, handling audio device addresses, including MAC and IP address validation, comparison, serialization, and conversion functions within the Android media framework.

classes.name: AudioDeviceTypeAddr
classes.description: Represents an audio device with type and address, providing comparison, serialization, and address sensitivity detection.

methods.name: isSenstiveAddress
methods.description: Checks if an address is a MAC or IP address, indicating sensitivity.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address as a C string.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Returns the address as a const reference to std::string.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the address and updates sensitivity status.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison based on type and address.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the device type to none and clears the address.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation, optionally hiding sensitive info.
